# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a boy with a small, dark face and black eyes that express gloomy and sullen looks.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Initially sullen, cheeky, and disdainful of female authority, Anthony behaves in a self-reliant manner and holds firm personal opinions. He displays a cheeky, insolent attitude toward rules, often defying expectations through disrespectful gestures or pranks. However, he respects physical strength and discipline, ultimately showing a more respectful and helpful side once won over.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## History

Anthony Tulk, an orphaned nephew taken in by Mrs. Laurence Tulk, began attending Brierley school under Nell Harcourt's instruction. From the start, he displayed open hostility and disdain toward Nell, believing female teachers to be useless. He repeatedly misbehaved, such as pouring water down a classmate's neck and placing a live mouse in Nell's desk drawer. When Nell lost her temper and gave him a harsh whipping with a wooden pointer, the punishment surprisingly earned Anthony's respect. Following the incident, he began acting politely toward Nell, offering to carry her books and speaking favorably of her, declaring that her beating was 'just as good as a man's.' When Nell eventually resigned her post, Anthony engaged in two deliberate fights with other boys to process his emotions over her departure.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
